description: This source file contains unit tests for WebSocket stream handling, focusing on cookie management including client-side cookie usage and server-set cookies, within the Chromium project's networking code.

classes.name: TestBase
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket stream tests, providing methods to create and connect WebSocket streams with specific parameters.

classes.description: Test class for verifying server-set cookie handling in WebSocket connections.

methods.description: Creates and connects a WebSocket stream with specified URL, origin, site for cookies, isolation info, cookie headers, and response body.
